name: Escort Probe (research)
description: Research only, for Andoris's bodyguards: can a mod spawn the game's SEAF trooper beside you, keep it with you, and does it fight and take hits? In a mission: Insert a trooper beside you (2 at most, a third replaces the oldest), Home following on/off, Delete takes them away. Logs their distance, health and the hits they take. Solo or host. Turn off when done.
